userInfo.aquiPodrasGestionarTu: ! Here you can manage your profile, update your information and enjoy a fast, efficient shopping experience. Our goal is to make your shopping fresh, easy and hassle free. Thank you for choosing us!

banner.enFrescagoNosApasiona: At FrescaGo, we are passionate about bringing the freshness of the countryside straight to your table. We are an online fruit and vegetable shop committed to offering top quality products, sustainably grown by local farmers.
banner.creemosEnLaImportancia: We believe in the importance of healthy eating and in the power of nature to nourish us.
banner.cadaPedidoEsCuidadosamente: Every order is carefully selected so you only receive the best. FrescaGo is more than a shop, it is a bridge between the countryside and your home, making sure you enjoy fresh, nutritious and flavourful food every day.
banner.confiaEnNosotrosPara: Trust us to bring freshness into your life!

bannerApp.llevaLaFrescuraDel: Take the freshness of the countryside in your pocket. With our app you can order fresh fruit and vegetables at any time, straight from your phone.
bannerApp.disponibleTantoEnGoogle: Available on both Google Play and the App Store, our app gives you a fast and convenient shopping experience.
bannerApp.descubreLoFacilQue: Discover how easy it is to eat healthily with high quality fresh products, selected especially for you.
bannerApp.imagenPromocionalDeLa: Promotional image of the FrescaGo app

bannerOrder.hazTuPedidoAhora: Order now and receive the best quality fruit and vegetables, sustainably grown by local farmers. Enjoy nutritious, flavourful food in every bite!

hero.compraEnFrescagoY: Shop at FrescaGo and get fruit and vegetables delivered straight to your door. Quality, freshness and flavour in every bite. Order now and taste the difference!

about.enFrescagoNosDedicamos: At FrescaGo, we are dedicated to bringing the freshness of the countryside straight to your table. Our goal is to offer you top quality products, sustainably grown by local farmers, so you can enjoy fresh fruit and vegetables every day.
about.laMisionDeFrescago: FrescaGo's mission is to make fresh, nutritious and sustainable food easier to reach, strengthening the bond between the countryside and the city. We believe in the importance of healthy eating and are committed to sustainability and to supporting local farmers.
about.nuestraVisionEsSer: Our vision is to be the leading online shop for fresh produce, promoting a healthy and sustainable lifestyle across the country.
about.ofrecerProductosDeLa: Offer top quality, fresh and nutritious products.
about.fomentarPracticasAgricolasSostenibles: Promote sustainable farming practices and support local farmers.
about.serUnPuenteDe: Be a bridge of trust between producers and consumers.
about.utilizarTecnologiaParaMejorar: Use technology to improve the shopping experience and the efficiency of delivery.
